messages:
Dana (acct-exec): HarborBank procurement sent back the SIG spreadsheet. They highlighted Q1.4 (data residency), Q3.2 (KMS rotation proof), and Q7.9 (third-party subprocessor list). Need completed answers + artifacts by Tuesday COB. Who can pick these up?
Priya Rao: I'll take data residency. We host in us-west and eu-west. I can provide the region config export and a short policy blurb.
Tom Becker: I'll own KMS rotation proof. I have `kms-rotation-policy.md` and a rotation log sample. Can scrub the key IDs.
Elena Ruiz: I'll handle subprocessor list and any required AUP/flow diagrams. Legal might want to approve exact wording.
Dana (acct-exec): Can sec-bot generate share links after uploads? Also HarborBank asked about whether backups are kept in the same region. Priya, can you confirm?
sec-bot: Please tag uploads with customer=harborbank for tracking. I'll produce links once objects land.
Priya Rao: Backups replicate to the same cloud region by default; cross-region backups are opt-in. I'll attach `region-backup-policy.pdf`.
Tom Becker: Uploading `kms-rotation-policy.md` now. Will replace real key IDs with hashed tokens `key-<hash>` as per ops guidelines.
legal-bot: Reminder: Any processor list or SOC excerpt that contains vendor names or contract terms requires Legal review before external sharing. Tag me with `@legal-bot review` when ready.
Elena Ruiz: Understood. I'll draft the subprocessor list and ping legal. Also note HarborBank requested SOC2 evidence for Q5. We have an executive summary; full SOC2 requires an NDA per legal.
Dana (acct-exec): OK plan: fill SIG answers, attach exec summary, and add conditional note for full SOC2 available after NDA. That should unblock procurement.
Tom Becker: Files uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/harborbank/kms-rotation-policy.md, https://s3.redwood.internal/harborbank/kms-rotation-log-20250120-hashed.txt
sec-bot: Objects verified: kms rotation policy + log. Generated share links above.
Priya Rao: Region docs uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/harborbank/region-backup-policy.pdf, https://s3.redwood.internal/harborbank/region-config-export.csv
Elena Ruiz: Draft subprocessor list uploaded and tagged for legal: https://s3.redwood.internal/harborbank/subprocessor-draft.csv @legal-bot review
legal-bot: Reviewing subprocessor-draft.csv. Two vendor names need redaction or customer-friendly aliases. ETA 4 hours.
Dana (acct-exec): Great, once legal clears, I'll finalize the Q7.9 answer. Tom/Priya, please confirm the exact one-line answers I should paste in the spreadsheet for Q3.2 and Q1.4 so they meet SIG's expected phrasing.
Tom Becker: For Q3.2 paste: "Keys are rotated at a 90-day cadence; rotation logs and policy are attached (kms-rotation-policy.md, kms-rotation-log-20250120-hashed.txt)."
Priya Rao: For Q1.4 paste: "Data is stored in customer-selected regions (us-west or eu-west). Backups remain in-region unless cross-region replication is requested; see region-backup-policy.pdf."
Dana (acct-exec): Thanks. One more ask from HarborBank: they want the name and contact for our security liaison for the vendor risk team. Can we provide a contact alias instead of personal email?
Elena Ruiz: We can provide security-liaison@redwood.com and reference triage SLA. I'll include that in Q9.1.
sec-bot: All artifacts present except legal-approved subprocessor list. Please mark the SIG response to indicate pending attachment if legal not done before submission.
Dana (acct-exec): OK team — I'll assemble the SIG responses, attach available artifacts, mark SOC2/full report as NDA-gated, and add pending note for subprocessor list if legal isn't done. Aiming to submit by Tuesday 17:00 PT. Post here once legal clears or if anyone hits a blocker.
legal-bot: Subprocessor list cleared with redactions. Uploaded final: https://s3.redwood.internal/harborbank/subprocessor-final.csv
Dana (acct-exec): Perfect. Uploading final SIG spreadsheet now and will ping HarborBank. Thanks everyone :rocket:
